findings.premise: The storage model provides a durable replay barrier for every required forget target, including a session, source conversation and whole project.
findings.evidence: U-06 requires targets to distinguish “a source conversation with its derived memories, a session or all project memory.” However, §3.11's strict Tombstone selector union permits only “kind:memory”, “kind:source” with one sourceId, or “kind:subject”. Source rows identify individual admitted occurrences. No scope-wide or source-stream invalidation boundary is specified, despite §3.10 mentioning project forget selectors. Tombstoning existing IDs cannot prevent a pending earlier event with an unseen memory/source/subject ID from activating after a project/session forget. Existing QueueFrame retains such pending events; it does not independently supply a deletion barrier. [files: docs/reqs/shared-project-memory.html, docs/epics/share-project-memory-across-agents-applications-E2026110117123b6d/S003/LLD.md, packages/project-memory/src/queue/types.ts, packages/project-memory/src/queue/file-queue.ts]
findings.action: Have the author define the persisted barrier and matching rules for broad forget targets, including treatment of pending earlier events and explicitly authorized later activity. Add a regression with an unprocessed event whose resulting IDs were unknown when forgetting committed.

findings.premise: The existing runtime supports ordered OwnedWork composition and retains ownership when cleanup is unverified.
findings.evidence: Read the complete runtime implementation and lifecycle tests. Admission stops across all participants; quiescence drains them serially and waits for models. Once quiescent, close attempts every participant in array order and releases the owner only if all closes succeed. A failed drain retains ownership and prevents resource release. This supports the proposed [queue, storeOwnedWork] composition without changing the successful shutdown algorithm. [files: packages/project-memory/src/runtime.ts, packages/project-memory/src/__tests__/runtime.test.ts]
findings.action: Add the specified real queue/store tests; preserve the distinction between quiescent close failures and unsettled drain failures.
